name: Check Dist
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths: [ 'dist/**' ]

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Fail if dist/ is modified
        run: |
          echo "Error: The dist/ directory has been modified in this pull request."
          echo "Please do not modify dist/ directly. Run 'npm run build' and 'npm run package' to regenerate it."
          exit 1

name: Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. 2.1.0)'
        required: true
      target_branch:
        description: 'Target branch (e.g. master)'
        required: true
        default: 'main'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.target_branch }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Bump version
        run: |
          npm version ${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }} --no-git-tag-version
          echo "VERSION=${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Package
        run: npm run package

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: 'chore: bump version to ${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }}'
          branch: ${{ github.event.inputs.target_branch }}
          file_pattern: package.json dist/

      - name: Create Git Tag
        run: |
          git tag v${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }}
          git push origin v${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }}

      - name: Create Release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }}
          release_name: Release v${{ github.event.inputs.release_version }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
